_doc: Pins of the opt-in plugin eval (decisions.accepted[PLUGINEVAL]). The model ids are the ones the official CI example uses (code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-evals, 'Run evals in CI'): pin them so a model rollout is not mistaken for a plugin change, and quote a result together with them and the claudeVersion of its JSON. Raise them on purpose and re-run.
